fixed a problem where a CPU looping in the kernel with but one runnable
task would give RCU CPU stall warnings
contained cond_resched() calls.  Unfortunately
performance regressions in Anton Blanchard's will-it-scale ""open1"" test.
The problem appears to be not so much the increased cond_resched() path
length as an increase in the rate at which grace periods complete
increased per-update grace-period overhead.
This commit takes a different approach to fixing this bug
moving the RCU-visible quiescent state from cond_resched() to
rcu_note_context_switch()
